title: Example Game Summon Route — Pets, Turret, Relic Tags
description: Example Game summon route: stack the summon-tagged relics, run the turret beside them, and put upgrade tokens on the summons.
meta: For summon-build searches. One family; the overview of every theme stays on the builds hub.
sources: Community build notes (commit to one family)
body:
Example Game summon route stacks summon-tagged relics, runs the turret beside them, and spends upgrade tokens on the summons so they hold aggro. This page is that route. The builds overview lists every theme.

Core idea

  • Prioritize the summon family early. Name the item tags your sources actually use.
  • The turret line plays as extra summons once the evolution lands.
  • Put tokens and buffs on the summons, not on a second damage tag.
  • Carry lines that persist gear between runs make the set much smoother. Name the real unlock.

First-floor checklist

  1. Pick a weapon family before the run (see weapons).
  2. Pre-load the Town Picker with summon-family relics once it is unlocked.
  3. Take every summon-tag item on the first floor before a shiny off-theme drop.
  4. Start the turret line as the second tag.
  5. Spend tokens on summon damage or summon count.

Run habits

  • Accept a secondary element only when it supports the turret. Keep the tag count tight.
  • In co-op the summons draw aggro so the party can play the mechanic.
  • After a boss, rebuild adjacency so summon pieces stay bonded.

Common mistakes

  • Spreading early picks across several families. The summons come online when the family is stacked.
  • Buffing your own damage while the pets die. Tokens belong on the summons.
  • Skipping the carry unlock, then rebuilding the set every run.

Quick FAQ

What counts as a summon item?
Anything your sources tag as spawning or buffing a summon. List the families, and leave exact ids to the journal when patches rename them.

Do the summons hold aggro?
State the community claim in one sentence and point at the clear video in Sources.

Does it carry into the harder mode?
Link the hard-mode page for what changes, and keep that page’s rules off this one.

Theme-level advice (“commit to one family”) can be stable while item ids move. Say so, and point at the journal plus the videos in Sources.
